note: Open RV park built in 2016 on a slope above Garden Bay on the Garden Peninsula; many sites 50-85 ft ('not recommended for motorcoaches' on some), 'Great View' sites facing the bay, a park model for rent on site 22, boat docking for guests and an on-site bar and grill (The Dock). --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026): $50-65/night (+$5 for 50-amp), all 41 sites full hookup 20/30/50-amp, showers/laundry/restrooms, season May 1 - Oct 31 2026, online (Open Campground) or phone with a 2-night online minimum and one-night stays by phone. Changed: added fees (the note's '$40 daily, Great View $50' is contradicted), electric 50, facilities, platform/url. Pull-through left (operator silent). Note cleaned of the wrong rates, season, minimum and RV Life line.
flags: Price gate: the operator's base is $50/night ('Our sites range between $50-$65 per night'), right at the US$50 line (not over it); 50-amp is +$5. No gateway within 40 km (Pictured Rocks 70 km); the family has not stayed here.
Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary operator claim): 'Our spacious and modern park sits on over 400' of waterfront' with boat docking for guests; the entry is 'bayview'.
